title: Towards Network Data Analytics in 5G Systems and Beyond
authors: Marcos Lima Romero; Ricardo Suyama
venue: Anais do XLIII Simpósio Brasileiro de Telecomunicações e Processamento de Sinais
summary: Reviews more than 70 NWDAF research articles to map methods and use cases and proposes two new NWDAF use cases oriented to operator monetisation.
key_result: Finds that academic NWDAF work concentrates on a narrow set of methods and use cases, largely dictated by which datasets are available.
limitation_or_critique: Regional symposium paper (also on arXiv 2506.04860) with a short-format review; selection method and depth are limited compared with a journal survey.

title: Network Automation and Data Analytics in 3GPP 5G Systems
authors: Miguel-Angel Garcia-Martin; Marco Gramaglia; Pablo Serrano
venue: IEEE Network
summary: Tutorial-style overview of the 3GPP network automation ecosystem built around NWDAF, covering its functionality, consumers and use cases from Release 15/16 and the extensions of Releases 17 and 18.
key_result: Shows how NWDAF evolved from a single slice-load use case into a general analytics producer feeding automated NF decisions across many use cases.
limitation_or_critique: Descriptive standards overview with no quantitative evaluation and no systematic coverage of the academic ML literature or of Rel-19 AI/ML enhancements.

title: A Survey of 3GPP Release 18 on Network Data Analytics Function Management
authors: Yuxia Niu; Song Zhao; Xiaoming She; Peng Chen
venue: 2022 IEEE/CIC International Conference on Communications in China (ICCC Workshops)
summary: Surveys the Release 18 key issues and candidate solutions for managing NWDAF itself, including NRM support for multiple NWDAFs, logical decomposition and NWDAF performance management.
key_result: Identifies NRM modelling of decomposed/multiple NWDAF instances and performance management of data collection and analytics output as open management issues.
limitation_or_critique: Workshop paper restating 3GPP study-item content, without evaluation and with limited link to ML lifecycle research.

title: Toward AI-Native 6G Systems: Standards Enablers for 6G Network Automation
authors: Sayantini Majumdar; Qing Wei; Susanna Schwarzmann; Riccardo Trivisonno; Georg Carle
venue: IEEE Communications Standards Magazine
summary: Argues that the 5G AI-overlay model (NWDAF as an add-on queried by NFs) limits autonomy and proposes 6G standards enablers where each NF embeds an intelligent agent coordinated by an AI controller (INTDAI).
key_result: Introduces an integrated distributed AI automation layer with AI data and AI control enablers as a path from overlay analytics to native AI in 6G.
limitation_or_critique: Vision-style magazine article whose benefits are illustrated on a single use case rather than measured on a testbed.

title: Architecture enhancements for 5G System (5GS) to support network data analytics services
authors: 3GPP
summary: Stage-2 specification of NWDAF: architecture, AnLF/MTLF split, data collection via DCCF/ADRF/MFAF, federated learning among NWDAFs, and the full catalogue of analytics IDs (NF load, QoS sustainability, abnormal behaviour, etc.).
key_result: Defines the normative analytics IDs, procedures and ML-model provisioning/accuracy monitoring that research prototypes are expected to comply with.
limitation_or_critique: Specifies interfaces and procedures but deliberately leaves algorithms, training data quality and performance targets to implementations.

title: Towards zero-touch network orchestration: An NWDAF-centered standards-compliant closed-loop approach
authors: Fatemeh Shafiei Ardestani; Noura Limam; Raouf Boutaba
venue: ITU Journal on Future and Evolving Technologies
summary: Presents a standards-compliant closed-loop framework that turns NWDAF into an active runtime orchestration component, with a UPF event exposure service, modular analytics engines with ML lifecycle management, and policy enforcement via control-plane NFs.
key_result: Fine-grained user-plane telemetry is collected with small overhead and enables anomaly mitigation and congestion-aware QoS adaptation at runtime.
limitation_or_critique: Journal extension of the NOMS 2026 paper (10.1109/NOMS69089.2026.11668240); evaluated on two lab use cases rather than at operator scale.

title: Agentic-NWDAF: Enabling Intent-driven Agentic Intelligence for Autonomous 6G Network Analytics
authors: Mazene Ameur; Bouziane Brik; Adlen Ksentini
venue: ICC 2026 - IEEE International Conference on Communications
summary: Adds an intent-aware agentic orchestration layer that translates natural-language OSS intents into NWDAF service calls using collaborating LLM agents and the Model Context Protocol.
data_or_testbed: benchmark of 100 NWDAF intents derived from 3GPP specs
key_result: Authors report high accuracy and good generalisation on their intent benchmark judged with an LLM-as-a-judge method.
limitation_or_critique: LLM-as-a-judge evaluation on a self-built benchmark leaves correctness, latency and safety of generated NWDAF calls only partly validated.

title: Enhanced Open-Source NWDAF for Event-Driven Analytics in 5G Networks
authors: Henok Daniel; Omar Alhussein; Jie Liang; Cheng Li; Ernesto Damiani
venue: arXiv preprint
summary: Builds an open-source NWDAF integrated with free5GC, adding event subscription/notification support in SMF and AMF and a mobility module that predicts the next handover cell.
method: event exposure extensions; ML handover-cell prediction
data_or_testbed: free5GC with 4 virtual gNBs and virtual UEs (two-week run)
key_result: Next-gNB handover prediction reached about 81% accuracy (80.65%) in the two-week emulated deployment.
limitation_or_critique: Preprint evaluated on emulated UEs and gNBs only, with a single mobility analytics use case.

title: Fair Federated Learning for Multi-Task 6G NWDAF Network Anomaly Detection
authors: Chunjiong Zhang; Gaoyang Shan; Byeong-Hee Roh
venue: IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems
summary: Applies fair federated learning to the 3GPP NWDAF architecture with a multi-task model detecting traffic anomalies of different device types, optimised via alternating gradient projection.
method: fair FL; multi-task learning; alternating gradient projection
key_result: The multi-task FL model detects anomalies for several device types at once and outperforms compared baselines in simulation.
limitation_or_critique: Simulation-only evaluation with no deployment on a 5G core, and venue (transportation systems) is outside the core-networking community.

title: A Protocol-Based Framework for AIaaS Lifecycle Management in 6G via NWDAF
authors: Júnia Maísa Oliveira; Daniel Fernandes Macedo; José Marcos NogueiraIEEE
venue: 2025 21st International Conference on Network and Service Management (CNSM)
summary: Proposes an enhanced NWDAF acting as an AI-as-a-Service lifecycle manager with model orchestrator, registry/validator, execution engine and feedback aggregator plus two new service-based protocols for training and execution.
key_result: Formal verification under message loss and complexity modelling indicate linear resource scaling up to 128 NFs.
limitation_or_critique: Validated by formal model checking and theoretical scaling only, with no prototype in a 5G core.

title: SAMMF: A Self-Adaptive Multi-Model Fusion Framework for NWDAF Traffic Anomaly Detection
authors: Mingchuang Zhang; Hongbo Tang; Jie Yang; Hang Qiu; Yu Zhao; Mingyan Xu; Yi Bai
venue: IEEE Networking Letters
summary: Proposes an NWDAF framework that adaptively selects high-performing models from a library per NF data source and fuses their outputs for anomaly traffic detection.
data_or_testbed: two public network anomaly detection datasets
key_result: Outperforms baseline single models in handling heterogeneous NF data for anomaly detection.
limitation_or_critique: Evaluated on generic intrusion datasets rather than data collected from 5G core NFs.

title: Real-Time Monitoring of 5G Networks: An NWDAF and ML Based KPI Prediction
authors: Abebu Ademe Bayleyegn; Zaloa Fernández; Fabrizio Granelli
venue: 2024 IEEE 10th International Conference on Network Softwarization (NetSoft)
summary: Builds a real-time monitoring solution for the 5G SBA around an in-house NWDAF and extends it with ML models predicting traffic KPIs, exporting metrics to Prometheus/Grafana.
key_result: Demonstrates standardised NWDAF-based monitoring with integrated KPI prediction on a running 5G core.
limitation_or_critique: Prediction accuracy and scalability are evaluated only on a lab testbed and the analytics are not fed back into control actions.

title: Enhancing Network Data Analytics Functions: Integrating AIaaS with ML Model Provisioning
authors: Ali Nadar; Jérôme Härri
venue: 2024 22nd Mediterranean Communication and Computer Networking Conference (MedComNet)
summary: Extends the OpenAirInterface NWDAF toward a Rel-17 architecture with AI/ML model sharing through APIs to an external AI-as-a-Service platform and an AI/ML ontology.
key_result: Demonstrates feasibility of ML model sharing between NWDAF and an AIaaS platform on an abnormal-traffic-behaviour use case.
limitation_or_critique: Feasibility demo without performance metrics for model transfer latency, accuracy or multi-vendor interoperability.

title: Model Drift in Dynamic Networks
authors: Dimitrios Michael Manias; Ali Chouman; Abdallah Shami
venue: IEEE Communications Magazine
summary: Discusses types of model drift threatening ML models deployed in 5G networks and proposes a drift detection and adaptation framework illustrated with a 5G core case study.
key_result: Shows that emulated changes in user behaviour degrade deployed models and that a detection-plus-adaptation loop can trigger remediation.
limitation_or_critique: Magazine-level treatment; the companion MeditCom 2022 paper (10.1109/MeditCom55741.2022.9928667) holds the core-specific framework and evaluation, both on small emulated testbeds.

title: Combining Network Data Analytics Function and Machine Learning for Abnormal Traffic Detection in Beyond 5G
authors: Abdelkader Mekrache; Karim Boutiba; Adlen Ksentini
venue: GLOBECOM 2023 - 2023 IEEE Global Communications Conference
summary: Proposes a microservice-based NWDAF architecture and integrates an LSTM autoencoder for abnormal traffic detection with the OpenAirInterface 5G core and RAN.
key_result: Shows end-to-end 3GPP-compliant data collection from a real 5G core and detection of abnormal traffic generated by a real UE.
limitation_or_critique: Training relies on the Milano telecom dataset rather than core-native data, and the evaluation is a single-use-case lab demo.

title: Securing Federated Learning Enabled NWDAF Architecture With Partial Homomorphic Encryption
authors: Changshi Zhou; Nirwan Ansari
venue: IEEE Networking Letters
summary: Proposes a federated-learning-enabled multi-NWDAF architecture where model updates shared among NWDAFs are protected with partial homomorphic encryption.
key_result: Simulation indicates the encrypted FL model sharing among NWDAFs is feasible while preserving data privacy.
limitation_or_critique: Letter-length simulation study with no integration into a 5G core and limited analysis of encryption overhead at scale.

title: Towards Supporting Intelligence in 5G/6G Core Networks: NWDAF Implementation and Initial Analysis
authors: Ali Chouman; Dimitrios Michael Manias; Abdallah Shami
venue: 2022 International Wireless Communications and Mobile Computing (IWCMC)
summary: Integrates a functional NWDAF into an open-source 5G core and analyses the NF interaction data it collects, outlining how the insights could drive intelligent network management.
key_result: Demonstrates practical NWDAF data collection over SBA interfaces and the type of NF-interaction insights it yields.
limitation_or_critique: Initial analysis without a deployed ML model or closed loop, on a small-scale emulated network.

title: An NWDAF Approach to 5G Core Network Signaling Traffic: Analysis and Characterization
authors: Dimitrios Michael Manias; Ali Chouman; Abdallah Shami
venue: GLOBECOM 2022 - 2022 IEEE Global Communications Conference
summary: Uses an NWDAF prototype on a working 5G core to collect control-plane signaling data and characterises intra-core NF interactions with unsupervised clustering.
key_result: Clustering of NWDAF-collected signaling exposes distinct NF interaction patterns usable for proactive load balancing.
limitation_or_critique: Characterisation study only; the identified clusters are not yet used for a control decision or validated on operator traffic.

title: A Distributed NWDAF Architecture for Federated Learning in 5G
authors: Youbin Jeon; Hyeonjae Jeong; Sangwon Seo; Taeyun Kim; Haneul Ko; Sangheon Pack
venue: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics (ICCE)
summary: Introduces a hierarchical NWDAF structure in which leaf NWDAFs train local models and a root NWDAF aggregates them by federated learning.
key_result: Argues the leaf/root design reduces analytics-data transfer and central overload while keeping data local.
limitation_or_critique: Consumer-electronics conference short paper with a conceptual architecture and limited quantitative evaluation.

title: Ensemble Learning-based Network Data Analytics for Network Slice Orchestration and Management: An Intent-Based Networking Mechanism
authors: Khizar Abbas; Talha Ahmed Khan; Muhammad Afaq; Wang-Cheol Song
venue: NOMS 2022-2022 IEEE/IFIP Network Operations and Management Symposium
summary: Combines an intent-based networking platform for end-to-end slice orchestration with NWDAF-style ensemble-learning analytics for resource-utilisation prediction and anomaly detection in a closed loop.
method: stacking ensemble learning; IBN closed loop
key_result: Stacking ensemble improved resource-utilisation prediction accuracy by up to about 20% and cut error by 45% versus baselines.
limitation_or_critique: Analytics are only loosely mapped to 3GPP NWDAF services and gains are shown on a limited dataset.

title: Intelligent network data analytics function in 5G cellular networks using machine learning
authors: Salih Sevgican; Meric Turan; Kerim Gokarslan; H. Birkan Yilmaz; Tuna Tugcu
venue: Journal of Communications and Networks
summary: Describes the NWDAF structure and protocols and evaluates ML models (linear regression, LSTM, RNN, logistic regression, XGBoost) for load prediction and anomaly classification on a 3GPP-field-based synthetic cell dataset.
key_result: Neural sequence models gave the best load prediction and gradient boosting the best anomaly classification among the compared models.
limitation_or_critique: Early and widely cited but relies on synthetic data with injected anomalies and does not run inside a real 5G core or NWDAF implementation.

title: Management and orchestration; Management Data Analytics (MDA)
authors: 3GPP
summary: SA5 specification of management-plane analytics (MDA): MDA functionality and service framework, MDA capabilities and use cases (coverage, fault, slice, energy), and the role of ML in MDA.
key_result: Defines MDA requests/reports and use cases complementing control-plane NWDAF analytics within the management loop.
limitation_or_critique: Management-plane focus with few academic implementations, so its interplay with NWDAF remains largely unevaluated.
